'''Knights''' were warriors in the culture of several [[Species/Legends|species]], including the [[Serp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]<ref name="SW64">[[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]]</ref> and the [[Anointed People]] of the planet [[Abonshee]].<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> In the Serp culture, knights were full-fledged [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. Before becoming a knight, a Serp had to serve as an apprentice warrior known as a [[Squire/Legends|squire]] for a time.<ref name="SW64" />
